Data scientist. MS student at Boston University. Interested in causal inference, football analytics, and MLOps.

I spent three years as a data scientist at BPI, where I built the MLOps library our team used to ship models — cutting development time by 70% and supporting more than 50 data scientists. Now I'm at BU going deeper on the methods, especially causal inference.

## Selected

::: {.selected-list}
- **[The new manager bounce: does sacking actually help?](blog/new-manager-bounce/)** — Using coarsened exact matching on 20 years of Big Five football data to test whether sacking a manager actually improves results.
- **[bpi-standard-ml](https://github.com/aadpaguio/bpi-standard-ml-demo)** — A Python MLOps library used by BPI's data science group. Model registry, feature store, drift detection.
- **[pyfanova](https://github.com/aadpaguio/pyfanova)** — Gradient-boosted trees made inherently interpretable through Functional ANOVA.
